title: An old one falls

stage.nudge: Someone is calling for help in the square.
stage.bring: an old body's last strength gives out this morning

text: {elder}, bent with years, has gone down on the stones of the square, grey-lipped and gasping. {kin} kneels beside them, calling for someone, anyone, to help.

choices.label: Carry {elder} home and sit with them (an hour)
choices.deed: carried {elder} home when they fell in the square

effects.text: You carry {elder} home between you. By the end of the hour their breathing has eased, and {kin} won't stop thanking you.

choices.label: Run for the healer
choices.deed: ran for the healer when {elder} fell in the square

effects.text: You find the healer and bring them at a run. {kin} grips your hand: "I won't forget this."

choices.label: Walk on
choices.deed: walked past when {elder} fell in the square

effects.text: You walk on. Behind you, {kin}'s voice cracks.
